question: Sam has an income of ₹ 9 lacs per annum. Which tax slab (new regime) of India is applicable to him for FY 22-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sam has an income of ₹ 9 lacs per annum.
 
• **15% tax slab **(new regime) of India is applicable to him for FY 22-23

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db484db7c894cc40ce86af6865e8f373b25f0d417efd7756f8fc502c7466faa7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the** Income Tax Act of India**, income tax is levied on all individuals, HUFs, partnership firms, LLPs, and corporations.
 
• If an individual's income exceeds the minimum threshold limit, they are subject to a slab system of taxation (known as the basic exemption limit).
 
• **Income Tax Slab:**
 
 
• Individual taxpayers in India pay income tax according to a slab system.
 
• Different tax rates are prescribed for different ranges of income under a slab system.
 
• It means that if a taxpayer's income rises, his or her tax rate rises as well.
 
• This sort of taxation helps the government to have progressive and equitable tax systems.
 
 
 
• The **rates for Tax slabs** are subject to change during every budget.
